fields.description: Skyvue Stellar is a residential tower in Sobha Hartland 2 with angular floor plates and homes arranged for different lagoon, community and city outlooks. Its original brochure includes one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts plus store- or study-equipped variants. The particular floor band and orientation determine which plan and view apply.

overview: The launch layouts pair internal suites with balconies and vary across floor bands. A room described as a half-bedroom may be labelled a store or study in the drawing. Confirm the approved use and the actual unit rather than treating every marketing label as an additional full bedroom.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Sobha Hartland 2 within Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Views in the brochure are assigned to particular floor groups, not guaranteed across the whole tower. No dedicated existing area mapping is assumed.
research.priceLabel: Developer-advertised starting guide · subject to stock
research.priceNote: The official page advertises AED 2.38m subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an AED 1.9m launch reference and marks its developer catalogue sold out. These are different dated selections; neither confirms a particular available home.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10% booking/60% construction/30% handover and a separate 20%/40%/40% option. The stages shown below reproduce the second option only. No current primary instalment calendar or signed commercial offer was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports June 2028, while later Impala material reports March 2029. The retrieved official brochure and project page do not resolve the date for a specific unit; contractual confirmation is required.
